{{dablink|For other uses of the word "four," see [[Four]].}}
The '''Four Holes''' is a [[sept]] of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]]. The sept hold is unknown. [[Aviendha]] once heard that [[Wise One]]s of the [[Jagged Spire]] and Four Holes septs could [[Healing|Heal]] using the [[One Power]]. She thought it was a boast.{{ref/book|4|39}}
